data.name: Sulochana
data.gender_notes: Sulochana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sulochana is a beautiful, radiant, and splendid name derived from the Sanskrit words su (good, excellent) and lochana (eyes, gaze). It suggests a gentle, graceful, and elegant woman whose beauty is akin to the moon, night, lotus, and moonlight. The name Sulochana carries the meaning “Beautiful, radiant, splendid” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sulochana usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, radiant, splendid and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sulochana is a Sanskrit name that represents the divine feminine energy. It signifies the beauty and grace of the divine mother, as well as the gentle, nurturing, and protective qualities of a woman. The name is believed to bring blessings of good fortune, happiness, and prosperity.
data.etymology: Sulochana belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, radiant, splendid.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sulochana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sulochana signifies beauty, grace, and elegance. In Hindu mythology and culture, beauty is often associated with the feminine divine and considered sacred. Sulochana, as a name, symbolizes the inherent beauty and radiance that exists within every woman, encouraging women to embrace and express their inner and outer beauty with grace.
data.spiritual_significance: The Sanskrit words su (good, excellent) and lochana (eyes, gaze) in the name Sulochana also hold spiritual significance. The eyes are often considered the windows to the soul in Hinduism. The name Sulochana can be interpreted as having good and radiant eyes or gazing at something good and radiant. Spiritually, this represents the importance of having a clear, pure, and unwavering inner vision and gaze, focusing on the divine and the good in themselves and the world around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sulochana: Radiant with beauty, illuminating the inner self with grace and elegance. A beacon of light in the spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sulochana was a beautiful Apsara in Hindu mythology. The name Sulochana carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Sulochana was a celestial nymph or Apsara in Hindu mythology.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Sulochana remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Priya Sulochana in Mumbai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Sulochana, which means "Beautiful, radiant, splendid". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
